description: This is a test class for OverlayDataNormalizer, containing unit tests for overlay data normalization logic in the com.anysoftkeyboard.overlay package.

classes.name: OverlayDataNormalizerTest
classes.description: Unit test class for OverlayDataNormalizer, testing overlay data normalization and color contrast logic.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes mock objects and test components before each test.

methods.name: testReturnsOriginalIfAllOkay
methods.description: Tests that the original overlay data is returned when it is valid and colors are appropriate.

methods.name: testReturnsOriginalIfIAllGood
methods.description: Tests that the original overlay data is returned when it is valid.

methods.name: testReturnsFixedIfInvalidButWasAskedToFix
methods.description: Tests that invalid overlay data is fixed to valid colors when fixing is requested.

methods.name: testReturnsFixedIfTextIsTooClose
methods.description: Tests that overlay data is fixed to ensure sufficient contrast when text is too close in luminance.

methods.name: testReturnsFixedToWhiteIfDarkIfTextIsTooClose
methods.description: Tests fixing overlay data to white text when background is dark and contrast is insufficient.

methods.name: testReturnsFixedToBlackIfLightIfTextIsTooClose
methods.description: Tests fixing overlay data to black text when background is light and contrast is insufficient.

methods.name: testLuminance
methods.description: Validates luminance calculation for various colors.

methods.name: setupOriginal
methods.description: Helper method to create mock overlay data and set it to be returned by the mock creator.
